text_blocks.snippet: To boil a perfect egg, bring a pot of water to a boil, gently lower the eggs in, set a timer for your desired doneness, and transfer them to an ice bath.
snippet_highlighted_words: bring a pot of water to a boil, gently lower the eggs in, set a timer for your desired doneness, and transfer them to an ice bath

list.snippet: Boil the Water: Fill a saucepan with enough water to completely cover the eggs and bring it to a rolling boil. You can add a pinch of salt to the water.
Lower the Eggs: Use a slotted spoon to gently lower the eggs into the boiling water to prevent cracking.
Set the Timer: Adjust the heat to maintain a gentle boil and start your timer right away according to the times below:
Stop the Cooking: Immediately transfer the boiled eggs into a bowl of ice water for 3 to 5 minutes to halt the cooking process and make peeling easier.
Peel: Tap the egg gently all over on the counter, roll it softly, and peel it starting from the wider bottom end—ideally while submerged in water.
